pr_title: xwayland: support views that change override-redirect status
pr_body:
This fixes https://github.com/swaywm/sway/issues/4600 by destroying the view and recreating it with the correct type (same as this Wayfire patch https://github.com/WayfireWM/wayfire/pull/706 )

I have tested with the Warframe launcher and Dark Souls 3, which both work fine with this.
pr_comments:
thanks for this fix! been playing around with it applied for the past week and it seems to work well. fixes one of the last remaining xwayland issues i've been experiencing (that i've run into at least) 

just as some user feedback, one quirk I am seeing is that for launchers like the league of legends client, it seems that when the view is destroyed and re-created (happens a lot in champ select), it garbles up something with the pointer coordinates in the app itself, i.e the pointer is actually offset 3 inches to the left. however when applying a move event to it (i.e super + mouse1 and drag) looks like the state is updated again and the cursor maps correctly. i'll make a follow-up issue for this if needed.
When will there be a new release with this patch? This is the only reason why I have installed i3 (for gaming)
We don't do ETAs, sorry. There'll be a new release when we'll decide it's time for a new release.
